Solution: 1) Break WALL IS STOP by pushing the WALL text block LEFT through the structural wall (text blocks pass through walls), making all walls passable. 2) Exit the bottom-right room through the now-passable walls. 3) Navigate to the rock grid and push the FL AG word block right (rocks are passable - no ROCK IS STOP). 4) Enter the top room and rearrange IS, WIN, FL AG blocks so FL AG-IS-WIN are consecutive in a row (FLAG IS WIN rule). 5) Touch the FLAG object to win.
